# Routine adherent-cell culture

> Illustrative planning draft · This example was written to demonstrate the workspace. It is not a generated or experimentally validated protocol.

## Purpose & scope

Organize a routine cell-culture workflow around a selected cell line and the laboratory’s approved SOP. General cell-culture references provide background; cell-line-specific conditions still need to be supplied.

## Before you begin

- Confirm the cell line, source, passage history, and the intended downstream experiment.
- Bring together the current laboratory SOP and the supplier’s cell-line documentation.
- Record the medium, vessel, handling constraints, and acceptance criteria that apply to this experiment.

## Workflow outline

### 01 · Assess the starting culture

Document culture identity, appearance, and the observations required by your laboratory’s quality checks. Resolve unexpected findings before continuing.

### 02 · Follow the approved handling procedure

Use the applicable SOP to define the sequence of handling steps. Keep each condition linked to its source, and leave unsupported values marked for review.

### 03 · Record the outcome

Record observations, deviations, and the next planned assessment. Keep the source version together with the experiment record.

## Parameters to confirm

| Item | Current status | Required source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Cell line and passage history | Not specified | Laboratory record |
| Medium and vessel | Needs confirmation | Cell-line documentation |
| Handling conditions | Needs confirmation | Approved laboratory SOP |
| Acceptance criteria | Needs confirmation | Experiment plan |

## Reference context

The background reference covers cell-culture fundamentals. It does not validate the example or replace a cell-line-specific procedure.

[1. Gibco Cell Culture Basics](https://www.thermofisher.com/us/en/home/references/gibco-cell-culture-basics.html)
